scope: 2026-02-15..2026-02-28 latest retained families after false-negative recovery
notes: This ledger covers the latest 81 audited rows in this scope, including recovered false negatives; seven rows are explicit pre-denominator demotion recommendations and are excluded from the active retained count.
No Change requires anchor_query to resolve to mechanism prose in the canonical owner chapter, not a receipt, list, metrics section, or ROADMAP intent.
Integrate means evidence review is complete but the durable mechanism delta is not fully carried by the current Books proposition.
Demote means the family should leave the Candidate Denominator and retain a family-specific pre-denominator closure.
